answer: Heartbeat deposits stop hoarding: each identity posts a liveness bond penalizing silence more than activity. An identity locks 50 units per epoch as a heartbeat deposit, refunded on a verified heartbeat; a missed heartbeat forfeits 25 units, and two misses typically freeze rewards 6 epochs. A harbor of 1,000 identities bleeds 25,000 per epoch; an ocean no forger can sustain, and a sonnet of 10 idle epochs costs 250,000 units.
